description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultChannelIdMapper class, which implements the IChannelIdMapper interface. It provides methods to generate grain key IDs based on stream IDs and grain bindings, supporting GUID and integer key types, with optional namespace inclusion.

classes.name: DefaultChannelIdMapper
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IChannelIdMapper, responsible for mapping stream IDs to grain key IDs based on binding properties.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Generates a grain key ID span based on grain bindings and stream ID, considering binding types and optional namespace inclusion.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Creates a GUID-based key ID span from the stream ID, optionally including the namespace.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an integer-based key ID span from the stream ID, optionally including the namespace.
